value.rationale: The signed minimum-variance extremizer objective is a natural exact input to a currently studied concentration-function conjecture. For the complete first heterogeneous three-site/three-summand parameter chamber, the result gives an explicit global maximum and a sharp sign phase whose independence from the largest parameter is structurally non-obvious. Both phase regions have positive interior. No unproved downstream theorem is assumed, and the narrower natural invariant is fully and exactly classified.
